selection: Every record is decoded and gated by tools/car_roster.py. The first five are the T-007
reference anchors (one per drivetrain mix) and must not move. The following ten are the
V1 audit's high/medium-confidence class-B cars in the manifest order of
_work/vehicle-pipeline/cars.json; each has an exact .model, a complete car-parts manifest,
a P52-style material pass and a measured 310 m scripted run.

cars.name: Corvette_ZR1_Stock
cars.why: the T-005d/T-007 baseline car; kept first so the existing single-car slice stays a regression anchor

cars.name: Lotus_ExigeCup260_Stock
cars.why: lightest car in the roster: 890 kg on the same tyres should out-accelerate and out-brake the Corvette

cars.name: Dodge_Challenger_Stock
cars.why: heaviest road car with a long wheelbase (2.981 m): inertially the opposite end from the Lotus

cars.name: Ford_FocusRS_Stock
cars.why: driveType 1 (front wheel) exercises the transmission path the RWD baseline never touches

cars.name: Audi_R8V10_Stock
cars.why: driveType 2 (four wheel) with the front differential torques populated: the third drivetrain branch

cars.name: Audi_TT_Stock
cars.why: V1 batch 1 (high confidence): exact audi_tt_stock.model, 100 draws / 52 static, AWD; second light AWD after the R8 V10

cars.name: Ford_F100_OffRoad
cars.why: V1 batch 1 (high confidence): exact ford_f100_offroad.model, 78 draws / 34 static, AWD with a 3.051 m wheelbase

cars.name: Ford_FR100_Stock
cars.why: V1 batch 1 (high confidence): exact ford_fr100_stock.model, 71 draws / 33 static, the longest wheelbase in the batch (3.233 m)

cars.name: Volkswagen_GolfW12650_Stock
cars.why: V1 batch 1 (high confidence): exact volkswagen_golfw12650_stock.model, 92 draws / 43 static, 850 Nm RWD hatch

cars.name: Ford_MustangGTR_Stock
cars.why: V1 batch 1 (high confidence): exact ford_mustanggtr_stock.model, 101 draws / 55 static, 850 Nm at an 8200 RPM limiter

cars.name: Dodge_ViperACR_Stock
cars.why: V1 batch 1 (high confidence): exact dodge_viperacr_stock.model, 83 draws / 48 static, 780 Nm RWD

cars.name: Audi_S3_Stock
cars.why: V1 batch 1 (high confidence): exact audi_s3_stock.model, 99 draws / 49 static, AWD

cars.name: Ford_Bronco_OffRoad
cars.why: V1 batch 1 (medium confidence: 20/20 preview-paired wheel draws), exact ford_bronco_offroad.model, 82 draws / 25 static; a driven screenshot must confirm wheel placement

cars.name: Nissan_SkylineR34ZTune_Stock
cars.why: V1 batch 1 (medium confidence: 20/20 preview-paired wheel draws), exact nissan_skyliner34ztune_stock.model, 96 draws / 46 static, 1050 Nm AWD
